name: Dual Wave Gallery
description: Scroll-driven gallery of two mirrored columns of uppercase labels that sway in a sine wave while a central thumbnail follows the label nearest the viewport center and highlights it.
contents: Two mirrored columns of uppercase text labels
Center thumbnail image that swaps to the focused item's image
Empty scroll spacers above and below the gallery
behavior: Labels move horizontally in a sine wave driven by scroll progress
The label closest to viewport center is highlighted and its image shown in the thumbnail
Thumbnail follows the viewport center, clamped inside the gallery
Optional smooth scrolling through GSAP ScrollSmoother
editableByProps: Labels, right column labels and images
Colors, font size, gaps, thumbnail size
Wave frequency and speed, spacer heights, smooth scroll

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the quickTo easing or duration of label motion
Change when the scroll animation starts and ends
needsCodeEdit.where: ScrollTrigger.create call with start and end

fixed: Includes scroll spacers above and below the gallery so the wave has scroll range
Enabling smooth scroll takes over page scrolling with ScrollSmoother and normalizeScroll, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Root paints its own background color across the full width
